This project is a fullstack automatic timetable generator web app with:
- Backend: Django (Python) + SQLite + REST API + Genetic Algorithm
- Frontend: React.js (Vite) + timetable display + export (HTML/CSV/PDF)
- All code should follow the described models, API, and UI requirements in the project brief.
- Use best practices for Django REST, React, and Python GA logic.
- All code should be modular and maintainable.
